_: CVEs that NVD matches to a component's version but that do not apply to what the firmware builds and calls. tools/advisories.py leaves them out of Trustify. justification: CycloneDX's impact analysis values. Check each again when the component, or what the firmware uses of it, changes.

CVE-2025-57052.detail: In cJSON_Utils.c (JSON pointers), which is not built: the firmware compiles cJSON.c only (third_party/cjson).

CVE-2026-67215.detail: In cJSON_Utils.c (JSON Patch), which is not built: the firmware compiles cJSON.c only.

CVE-2026-67217.detail: In cJSON_Utils.c (JSON Patch), which is not built: the firmware compiles cJSON.c only.

CVE-2026-67216.detail: In cJSON_Compare(), which the firmware never calls.

CVE-2026-16554.detail: Needs a string of about 859 million control characters to overflow a 32-bit size; the devices have less than 1 MB of RAM, and nothing they print comes near.

CVE-2025-66442.detail: A timing side channel that only LLVM's select-optimize introduces; the firmware is built with GCC (ESP-IDF's and Zephyr's toolchains).
